title: A Central Limit Theorem for Coprime Pair Counts in Randomly Translated Disks
summary: We study the distribution of the number of coprime lattice points in randomly translated disks. We prove that its spatial variance is asymptotic to $σ^2r\log r$ and establish a central limit theorem under the corresponding normalization, where $σ^2$ is an explicit positive constant. By truncating the numerators of rational frequencies in lowest terms, the proof reduces higher-moment estimates to counting squarefree denominators in zero-sum relations.
